Megan R.: Quick handoff — handling incident from my shift, leaving notes before I sign off. TL;DR: 20:30 UTC spike in hosted API latency (model=redwood-small). Pager fired. Mitigations applied: scaled dedicated pool, rolled back routing tweak, warmed KV cache. Customer impact: elevated latency for ~12% of requests for ~18m, error rate briefly climbed but stayed <0.1%.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2056001 — latency spike affecting hosted/text-generation (severity=sev2). Pages sent to @oncall-primary @oncall-secondary at 20:31:05 UTC.
Megan R.: Timeline of actions I took:
- 20:31: observed increased queue depth on q-worker-3
- 20:33: ran quick traceroute to model-serving group, saw backlog in batcher
- 20:35: ran `rwctl pool scale dedicated-pool-7 --replicas 10` to add capacity
- 20:42: disabled an experimental routing rule (rule-id: route-exp-2025) that routed requests to a low-memory variant
- 20:45: triggered KV cache pre-warm for hot prefixes
- 20:47: latency trending back to normal, monitoring around 20:55 confirmed p95 within SLO
Dan K.: thanks — good notes. i'll take primary for the next shift. Any remaining tasks I should own besides monitoring?
Megan R.: please own the postmortem ticket and ensure we have reproducer steps. Also check whether the rollback we did should be turned into a permanent routing guard.
Priya S.: i'll be secondary. one thing: EU coverage gap 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow — current rota has no dedicated backup for that window. we should decide now whether to add a temp backup or rely on cross-region fallbacks.
Nora L.: tagging infra-schedule — we can bump an oncall for that window if needed. what's expected load then? Megan?
Megan R.: expected load low, but if the routing tweak is re-enabled accidentally it could trigger. i'd prefer a temp backup for the 02:00-04:00 window. Dan: can you and Priya coordinate a quick runbook-check before that window?
Dan K.: got it. i'll do a runbook dry-run at 01:30 UTC. Priya — can you be on-call-ready for the 02:00-04:00 slot? i'll take first hour.
Priya S.: yes i can cover 03:00-04:00. i'll join the 01:30 dry-run. please drop the runbook link here.
Megan R.: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.io/latency-spike-handling
Postmortem template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5023 (i created the ticket, placeholder title "INC-2056001 - latency spike postmortem")
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run at 01:30 UTC (automated reminder to participants: Dan K., Priya S.).
Dan K.: action items I'll own:
- File reproducer steps into RED-5023 by EOD my timezone
- Add routing-guard entry to config repo and open PR (PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/XXXX)
- Confirm autoscale thresholds and add safety margin (+20%) if not present
Priya S.: action items I'll own:
- Join dry-run at 01:30 UTC and validate runbook steps
- Add a small smoke test to the canary that exercises KV cache warmup flow
- Monitor EU region metrics 01:45-04:15 and escalate if any anomaly
Megan R.: filler notes:
- logs saved to s3://inc-logs/INC-2056001/
- snapshot of pool metrics: attached in incident doc
- temp mitigation: disabled route-exp-2025. DO NOT re-enable without owning rollback plan.
Dan K.: quick question: is there any customer that needs a proactive update? support said one enterprise tenant (Acme Corp) hit p95 slowness for a brief window.
Megan R.: yes — support notified Acme via ticket SUP-7824 and flagged for follow-up. I'll add a short summary to the support ticket before I go.
Nora L.: scheduling note — retro proposed: Thu 15:00 UTC, 45m. I'll create the calendar invite and the retro doc. Anyone object to Thu 15:00?
Dan K.: thumbs up for Thu 15:00. i'll prep timeline graphs.
Priya S.: ok for Thu 15:00. i'll draft suggested mitigations section.
Megan R.: final handoff: primary -> Dan K.; secondary -> Priya S. Coverage gap resolved by temporary backup (Nora will confirm assignment in schedule). Post-handoff outstanding items: RED-5023 (postmortem), infra PR for routing-guard, support follow-up SUP-7824, retro Thu 15:00 UTC. Please ack when you have everything.
Dan K.: ack. i have everything and will start with reproducer and infra checks.
Priya S.: ack. see you on dry-run at 01:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Megan R.: handing over. i'm logging off — ping me if things go sideways, but i'll be mostly offline after 21:15 UTC. :wave:
eng-oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from Megan R. to Dan K. at 21:12:34 UTC. Incident INC-2056001 status: monitoring.
